title: Server configuration of the Blossom mod (config/blossomscript.json)

registry.description: Where the dependencies that are not already on disk come from. Off when absent.

directory.description: A folder laid out as <root>/<name>/<version>/, each holding a normal project.

url.description: The base url of a static index.json plus zip archives. Every entry needs its sha256.

io.description: The folders core.io can reach. Nothing is reachable when absent.

roots.description: Name of the root -> folder, written relative to the world folder. A path outside the world is dropped with a warning.

writable.description: Which of those roots can also be written to. A root is read-only unless it is named here.

http.description: The hosts core.http can talk to. Nothing is reachable when absent.

hosts.description: The allowed patterns: an exact name, *.domain for its subdomains, or * for everything (logged as a warning).

schemes.description: The allowed schemes. Default: https only. Allowing http is logged: those requests travel unencrypted.

timeout_ms.description: How long a request waits for an answer before failing.

max_response_bytes.description: Bodies larger than this are refused instead of read.

follow_redirects.description: Whether to follow 3xx answers, at most five hops, checking the host of every one against the list.

watchdog.description: Execution limits for the apps that do not declare their own in blossom.json.

timeout_ms.description: How long a block of code may run before it is stopped. Zero or less removes the limit, and is logged.
